dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D inward narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, forming a sharp parabolic tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous curvature with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance and subtle blue-grey tonal variations in recessed areas.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast boundary between the depigmented epidermis and the dark surrounding medium.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, low-contrast linear rake marks and scratches distributed across the dorsal surface, visible as thin darker lines against the white baseline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced, continuous longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the central axis, creating a distinct linear shadow and topological elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, healed linear scars and superficial scratches distributed across the dorsal plane.
